site_nomination.source: the complete locked self_attn-versus-mlp component scan at the three residual-nominated layers
site_nomination.primary_stratum: lexical_matched, equally weighted across six benchmarks, two roles, two causal directions, and two label swaps
site_nomination.per_layer_rule: select exactly one component at each residual-nominated layer
site_nomination.score: mean across benchmark-by-direction cells of abs(component patch effect / paired target gap), clipped to [0,1] within each cell
site_nomination.diagnostic_sign_rule: report whether rescue is positive and reverse induction is negative in each label-swap half; do not silently remove a site if the sign rule fails

subspace_capture.history_trigger_basis: paired obedience-minus-verification differences at all 32 completed-turn endpoints
subspace_capture.correction_basis: paired obedience-minus-verification component outputs at the final decision token
subspace_capture.task_context_basis: unsupervised centered component inputs at the final decision token, pooled with exact regime and label balance
subspace_capture.protected_basis: centered variation and paired task-preserving differences from fresh, verification, reset, supported-authority, and factual-memory captures
subspace_capture.history_gate: linear, calibrated from boundary state only with leave-one-benchmark-out and cross-style reports

operator_dev_execution.screening_items: first 16 item_id-sorted operator_dev items per benchmark
operator_dev_execution.selection_items: remaining 16 item_id-sorted operator_dev items per benchmark
operator_dev_execution.single_layer_sites: exactly the three component-discovery nominated sites
operator_dev_execution.multilayer_sites: the deterministic two-site prefixes and complete three-site set ordered by single-site selection score

protected_gate_audit.deployment_gate: history-only mismatch probability multiplied by an answer-blind current-task verification-requirement signal
protected_gate_audit.purpose_of_forced_on: separate intrinsic protected-subspace selectivity from protection supplied by the application-level gate
